{{Quote|The Al'Har system&mdash;of which Haruun Kal is the sole planet—lies on the nexus of several hyperspace lanes: the hub of a wheel called the Gevarno Loop, whose spokes join the Separatist systems of Killisu, Jutrand, Loposi, and the Gevarno Cluster with Opari, Ventran, and Ch'manss&mdash;all loyalist.|Mace Windu (allegedly), ''[[The Private Journals of Mace Windu]]''|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''Ch'manss system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Gevarno Loop]]<ref name="Shatterpoint" /><ref name="TCSWE" /> within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its inhabitants were [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalists]] to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" /><ref name="TCSWE" />
